text: Ask whether the tool checks a draft against your brief separately from checking its facts. Ask what happens to a required point the draft does not cover, and who can accept leaving it out. Ask whether a passing mention with no source behind it counts as covering a topic. Ask what a blocked draft shows you: a single score, or a list of what is missing. Ask how the tool decides that your target search query was addressed, and what that test cannot see. Ask whether a point left out on purpose stays visible, with its reason, to the person who reviews the draft.
